request: Analyze GSE185957 for PMID 35470975 (Impact of obesity on the molecular response to a single bout of exercise in a preliminary human cohort.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (polyA, Illumina HiSeq 4000), human vastus lateralis biopsies (S2.4.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 4 lean + 4 obese adults, each biopsied at rest (pre) and 3.5 h after 30 min single-leg cycling at 70% VO2peak (post); 16 libraries (ABS.p2, S2.1.p1, S2.3.p1)
final.repeated_measure_unit: subject (pre and post biopsy from the same person; rest biopsy right leg, post biopsy exercised left leg, separate days) (S2.3.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Within-person transcriptional response to a single bout of endurance exercise (post vs pre), estimated separately in lean and in obese participants (S3.2.p1, FIG2)
planned_contrasts: lean: post vs pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 419 up, 132 down = 551 DEGs)
obese: post vs pre (S3.2.p1; paper: 82 up, 22 down = 104 DEGs)
baseline obese vs lean pre (S3.1.p1; 97 up, 65 down) - not an exercise contrast, out of scope
final.paper_method: edgeR negative-binomial GLM on featureCounts gene counts (S2.4.p1); design terms and subject blocking not stated
final.paper_normalization: edgeR (deposited file is edgeR-normalized CPM, GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S3.1.p1 (adjusted p < 0.05, log2(fold-change) > +/-0.5); FIG2/FIG7 report FDR / adjusted p = 0.05

final.paper_pathways: GSEA: lean post-exercise downregulation of mitochondrial translation and OXPHOS gene sets, upregulation of RTK signaling; obese: no regulated transcript gene sets (S3.2.p2)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper-first reconstruction. The exercise estimand is the paired pre/post change within each BMI group (S3.2.p1, FIG2 volcano plots per group). The explicit DE threshold (adjusted p<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.5) is stated in S3.1.p1 for the baseline comparison and is the only stated threshold; FIG2 uses FDR on the y-axis, so the same rule is taken for the exercise contrasts (medium confidence). edgeR GLM on counts is the paper's method; whether subject was blocked is not stated.

checks: GEO: Homo sapiens skeletal muscle, Mayo Clinic, STAR/hg38/featureCounts/edgeR matches S2.4.p1
16 samples = 8 subjects x pre/post, groups leanpre/leanpost/obesepre/obesepost 4 each matches N=4+4 (ABS.p2)

ownership.reasoning: Accession cited in the paper; processing description and sample structure match the paper's RNA-seq cohort.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (subject5post, ...) equal the metadata title column exactly for 16/16 samples (inspect alignment_keys). status and time are parsed from the GEO group field; subject from the subject characteristic (each subject has exactly one pre and one post).

matrix.matrix_type: linear normalized CPM (edgeR-normalized counts per million)
matrix.recommended_method: limma on log2(CPM+1) with subject blocking
matrix.reasoning: File is GSE185957_norm_cpm.txt.gz; data_processing says 'Supplementary_files_format_and_content: norm_cpm.txt'. Values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.636 driven by zeros), column sums 0.84-1.12 million (CPM on TMM-adjusted library sizes). The paper's input (raw featureCounts counts for edgeR) was not deposited, and library sizes are not given, so counts cannot be recovered.

candidates.reason_rejected: non-integer, column sums ~1e6: CPM, not counts

design.subject: subject

final.analysis_type: paired two-timepoint, stratified by BMI group

design.reasoning: The paper reports exercise effects separately per BMI group (S3.2.p1, FIG2 A/B), so status is a stratum and time (post vs pre) is the factor, with subject as the repeated-measure key. n=4 pairs per group (small; paper calls itself preliminary, S5.p1). The baseline obese-vs-lean and obesity-by-exercise interaction are not exercise-effect contrasts asked for here and were not separately quantified as DEG counts for the interaction in the paper; they are left out. Suitability split_plan proposes a female-only exploratory comparison; within strata it is either identical to the lean analysis (all lean are female) or has 2 pairs (obese females), so it is not run.

candidates.value: pooled post vs pre across all 8 subjects
candidates.reason_rejected: paper analyzes lean and obese separately (S3.2.p1); pooling changes the estimand
equivalent fixed-effect estimand to per-stratum paired fits but pools residual variance across groups; paper's per-group reporting favors separate fits

covariance.reasoning: Each subject contributes a pre and a post biopsy (S2.3.p1); subject is the blocking unit. Sex is not in GEO metadata and is not added as a covariate (it is constant within subject and absorbed by the subject block). Leg (rest right / exercise left) and day are completely aliased with time by design (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1: not randomized) and cannot be separated; recorded as a caveat, not a covariate.

paper_route.method: edgeR negative-binomial GLM on featureCounts counts
paper_route.reason: Only edgeR-normalized CPM is deposited (GSE185957_norm_cpm.txt.gz); raw counts and library sizes are not available, so a count-based NB GLM cannot be fitted. CPM must not be rounded into counts.

deviations: limma on log2(CPM+1) instead of edgeR NB GLM on counts
low-expression filter CPM >= 1 in >= 4 of the 8 samples per stratum (paper's filter not stated; paper reports 13,175 transcripts identified)
subject blocking assumed (paper does not state its GLM design)

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: linear normalized expression -> log2(x+1) then limma. Paired design via subject term. Filter on deposited CPM values approximates the usual edgeR filterByExpr/CPM filter.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule applied to the limma-on-log2CPM deviation route; rule stated in S3.1.p1 and assumed to carry to the exercise contrasts (FIG2 uses FDR).

threshold.reasoning: S3.1.p1: adjusted p-value < 0.05, log2(fold-change) > +/-0.5. Audit: BH < 0.05 without fold-change cutoff.

caveats: Paper's edgeR-on-counts route blocked: only normalized CPM deposited; limma on log2(CPM+1) runs instead.
Exercise is aliased with leg (rest right leg, exercise left leg) and with day; not randomized (S2.2.p1, S2.3.p1). The post-vs-pre contrast estimates exercise + leg + day.
n = 4 pairs per group; preliminary study (S5.p1). Results are low-powered.

Sex: X/Y inference (suitability sex check) gives lean subjects 1-4 all female and obese subjects 5,6 male / 7,8 female; paper text says lean 2F/2M and obese 4F (S2.1.p1) or 2F/2M each (Table 1). Pre/post of every subject agree in sex, and our lean count matches the paper's lean count, so GEO group labels are taken as the labels the paper analyzed. Per-sex exploratory split not run: female-only lean equals the lean analysis, female-only obese has 2 pairs (< 3), males have 2 pairs (< 3).

Obese post vs pre: 0 DEGs (padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>0.5) in paired, unpaired and pooled-variance paired-change limma fits, vs 104 in the paper; min padj 0.32. Paper's count not reproduced on the deposited CPM; the paper's edgeR NB GLM on raw counts may have more power, and its exact model is not stated.

GSEA (Hallmark, not the paper's library): lean shows OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION negatively enriched, consistent with the paper's lean mitochondrial/OXPHOS downregulation (S3.2.p2); obese shows one set (INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE, negative) where the paper reports none.

study.reasoning: Paper counts from S3.2.p1 (lean 419 up + 132 down; obese 82 up + 22 down). No individual transcripts are named for the exercise contrasts in the text.

discrepancies.paper: edgeR NB GLM on featureCounts counts (S2.4.p1)
S2.1.p1: lean 2M/2F, obese 4F; Table 1: 2F/2M in each group
discrepancies.data: no sex in GEO metadata; X/Y inference: lean 4F, obese 2M/2F; each subject's pre/post agree
0 under the paper rule on every limma route tried

enrichment.reasoning: Paper ran GSEA on the exercise comparison (S2.7.p1, S3.2.p2); Hallmark used here as available gene-set library.
